inscriptions.inscription:
Artist seal: Fan Qi 樊圻. 

Poem by Li Bing 李炳 (1600s): 

Maple leaves drift in the wind, the autumn gusts bracing,
Hibiscus flowers steeped with water, the evening breeze light.
The moonlight's slanting beams shine upon dreaming lovers.
No wonder that pair of fowl should dream of the absent partners.
inscriptions.inscription_remark: The poem is an allusion to a Ming Play, Yuan Yang Meng 鴛鴦夢, by Ye Xiaowan 葉小纨 (c. 1613-c. 1657), in which two separated lovers can meet each other only in their dreams.
